create_concat_sentences_dataset: create a ConcatSentencesDataset that concatenates multiple FairseqDataset instances into a single dataset
getitem_concatenated_tensor: get a concatenated tensor from multiple datasets at a given index using __getitem__
collate_concat_samples: collate samples from a ConcatSentencesDataset using the first dataset's collater method
sum_sizes_across_datasets: sum the sizes property across all underlying datasets in a ConcatSentencesDataset
prefetch_concat_dataset: prefetch indices across all datasets that support prefetching in a ConcatSentencesDataset
